title: Spiritual Journey to Kandy: The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
description: Immerse yourself in the cultural heart of Sri Lanka and discover the sacred Temple of the Tooth.
author: Tourvir Team
content: Kandy, the last royal capital of Sri Lanka, is nestled among misty hills and tea plantations. The crown jewel of Kandy is the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic (Sri Dalada Maligawa), which houses a tooth relic of the Buddha. Exploring the temple complex offers a profound glimpse into Buddhist rituals and traditional Kandyan architecture. Make sure to stroll around the picturesque Kandy Lake at sunset!
